client_alerts.name: client_alerts
client_alerts.description: Legacy Gateway shell link or button. Not required when a Pending Cancellations filter chip is already on client-alerts. Zero or multiple matches hold.

pending_cancellations_chip.name: pending_cancellations_chip
pending_cancellations_chip.description: Modern Gateway filter chip on client-alerts. The accessible name may include a count, for example Pending Cancellations (3). aria-pressed, aria-selected, or aria-checked true means the view is selected. A bare chip with the alerts table is the selected filter. Client Alerts is not clicked when this chip is present.

pending_cancellations.name: pending_cancellations
pending_cancellations.description: Legacy Client Alerts option, used only when no filter chip is present. The run holds unless the combobox, tab, or chip shows Pending Cancellations.

documents.name: documents
documents.description: Personal-lines policy documents entry. Absent with a single Billing control is the commercial hold path, not a download.

billing.name: billing
billing.description: Billing folder under Documents, or the only folder on a commercial policy that has no Documents route.

pending_cancellation_notice.name: pending_cancellation_notice
pending_cancellation_notice.description: Exactly one of these notice names is downloaded for personal lines. Live accessible name is UNVERIFIED until a hermes-test-01 run.
